name: Cyclone 3rd ET electronic
summary: Current manufacturer and mainland indexes identify the WheelTop electronic configuration as Cyclone 3rd ET / 龙卷风三代 ET. The dated China-market price remains a historical promotion lead, while current final mainland checkout terms still require verification.

frame.construction: Aero-shaped high-modulus carbon frame and fork with 12×142/12×100 mm thru-axles, a matching aero carbon seatpost and fully internal routing; the lay-up schedule and molding process are not published
frame.stiffness_evidence: The current manufacturer page describes the exact ET frame as engineered for stiffness and efficient power transfer, and one current exact-model owner reports stable handling and a responsive feel during an initial 70 km ride. No measured stiffness, deflection or independent comparative protocol was found.

category_details.note: WheelTop EDS TX 2×12. The manufacturer publishes fitted 700×28C tires but no exact maximum tire clearance; two dated coupon observations remain an uncertainty range.
